question: Should maintainers land this compact skills prompt format change after exact-head gates, given it refreshes persisted session snapshots and changes the model-visible compact catalog shape for tight budgets?
rationale: The implementation and proof look strong, but the diff intentionally changes compatibility- and session-state-sensitive prompt behavior, so accepting that upgrade behavior is a maintainer merge decision.

options.title: Land With Existing Proof
options.body: Accept the compact prompt format change because it preserves identities first, refreshes session snapshots via the format marker, and includes focused, changed-surface, and live prompt proof.

options.title: Refresh Exact-Head Gates First
options.body: Require a rebase or merge-queue run against current main before landing if maintainers want fresh CI on the final merge result.

options.title: Pause For Broader Skills Policy
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want compact descriptions bundled with omitted-skill keys, priority, or smart skill-loading policy instead of landing the narrower formatter fix now.

recommendation.title: Land With Existing Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the compact prompt format change because it preserves identities first, refreshes session snapshots via the format marker, and includes focused, changed-surface, and live prompt proof.
